text:
jessica-cs: Hey team, AcmeMaps reporting intermittent 403s for the /v1/embeddings/batch endpoint after SSO key rotation this morning. single-item embeddings OK, batch fails.
acme_infra: Yep, we started seeing errors at ~09:12 UTC. Single calls return 200, batch (n>1) returns 403 with message 'missing: embeddings.generate'.
jessica-cs: Error payload from customer: `{"error":"permission_denied","message":"missing: embeddings.generate","code":403}`
acme_infra: Repro steps I sent them: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_ABC123" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"inputs":["a","b"]}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch
```
Response: 403. Then with single input: `{"input":"a"}` returns 200.
sam-eng-ml: Interesting. That sounds like scope enforcement difference between batch and single handlers. Can you paste token claims (jwt) from the request?
acme_infra: Sent via DM to @jessica-cs: `{"sub":"svc:acmemaps","scopes":"inference.generate rerank.score","exp":1710000000}` — note: embeddings scope absent.
jessica-cs: They say their provisioning flow should have granted `embeddings.create` but rotation might've cached old claim set.
matt-eng-infra: On our side, logs show the request authorizer checks for `embeddings.create` (batch) and `embeddings.generate` (single) — odd mismatch. Pulling proxy logs...
matt-eng-infra: Proxy log excerpt: `authz: token=svc_ABC123 scopes="inference.generate, rerank.score" endpoint=/v1/embeddings/batch -> deny missing embeddings.create`
sam-eng-ml: That explains it: batch path is checking for `embeddings.create` but tokens issued by the old SSO flow used `embeddings.generate`. Need to map aliases or add backward compatibility.
olivia-oncall: Can we confirm whether the provisioner hit a delimiter bug? We had an earlier issue where scope CSVs containing spaces got truncated.
jessica-cs: Customer says they provisioned via SSO SCIM sync. I asked them to re-provision a token and gave a temporary manual key that includes `embeddings.create`. They tried new token and batch now works.
acme_infra: Confirmed — re-provisioned key worked: batch 200.
matt-eng-infra: Found root cause: our provisioner normalizer had a replace that converted `embeddings.generate` -> `embeddings.generate` (no-op) but dropped `embeddings.create` when comma separated list had trailing space + quoted CSV. Patch pushed to staging that preserves both scopes.
sam-eng-ml: Will submit a small compatibility rule to accept `embeddings.generate` as alias for `embeddings.create` in batch path while we roll out fix.
jessica-cs: ETA for patch to prod?
matt-eng-infra: Hotfix merged. Deploying to authz-lambda in 10m, then to proxy.
deploy-bot: deploy started: authz-lambda v2024.03.14-hotfix (by matt-eng-infra).
matt-eng-infra: Deployed to prod, monitoring.
olivia-oncall: Can someone follow up with AcmeMaps and suggest they rotate back to SSO token after we verify SCIM entries are normalized?
jessica-cs: I'll follow up and ask them to test their rotation once we confirm normalizer fix landed. Thanks all. :tada:
acme_infra: Verified again at 09:40 UTC — SSO-rotated token now returns 200 for batch. Thanks!
jessica-cs: Closing the loop in ticket #CS-20481. NOTE: add regression test for batch vs single embedding scope aliasing.
sam-eng-ml: Adding test to unit suite now.
jessica-cs: Great. Closing thread.
